sa: तमब्रवीत् तथा शङ्खस्तीव्ररोषसमन्वितः। स्तेयं त्वया कृतमिदं फलान्याददता स्वयम्॥
en: Filled with great anger, Shankha said to him,—You have committed theft by taking yourself these fruits.

sa: भ्राता हि चिरयातो नः सहदेव तवाचजः। तथैवानय सोदर्यं पानीयं च त्वमानय॥
en: “O Sahadeva, our brother (Nakula) who was born (just) before you, has been long out. Go and bring him and also water.

sa: एवं दत्त्वा वरं राज्ञे सर्वे ते च दिवौकसः। गताः स्वभवनं देवा ऋषयश्च तपोधनाः॥
en: Having granted these boons to the king, the dwellers of heaven, as also all those Rishis having penances for wealth, returned each to his respective place.

sa: नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया। शक्य एवंविधो दुष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा।॥
en: Not by the study of the Vedas, not by penances, gifts or sacrifices, can I be seen in this form of mine which you have seen.

sa: भीष्म उवाच देवानां तु मतं ज्ञात्वा वसुना पक्षसंश्रयात्॥ छागेनाजेन यष्टव्यमेवमुक्तं वचस्तदा।
en: Bhishma said Learning the opinion of the gods, Vasu, moved by partiality for them, said that sacrifices should be celebrated with animals.

sa: ऋषय ऊचुः बीजैर्यज्ञेषु यष्टव्यमिति वै वैदिकी श्रुतिः। अजसंज्ञानि बीजानि च्छागं नो हन्तुमर्हथ॥
en: The Rishis said The Veda declares that in sacrifices the offerings should consist of seeds. Seeds are called Ajas. You should not kill goats.

sa: मागधानामधिपति जयत्सेनं जनार्दन। आवार्यं सर्वतः पत्न्यः प्ररुदत्यः सुविह्वलाः॥
en: Behold, O Janarddana, those Magadha ladies crying and standing around Jayastsena the king of the Magadhas.

sa: इहाद्य रजनी राम वसाम शुभदर्शन ॥ श्वः प्रभाते गमिष्यामस्तदाश्रमपदं मम।
en: Here, O Rāma of gracious presence, shall we pass the night; and morrow morning, went to that hermitage of mine.

sa: वै स ददर्श महात्मानं ज्वलन्तमिव पावकम्। सूक्ष्मक्षौमाम्बरधरं मुनिभिः सार्धमक्षयैः॥ सोऽभिवाद्य ततो रामं प्राञ्जलिः प्रयतेन्द्रियः। उवाच वाक्यं धर्मज्ञं धर्ममेवानुचिन्तयन्॥
en: And there he saw the great Rāma, clothed in silk raiment burning like fire in the midst of the ascetics. There upon remembering his duty he saluted Rāma, conversant with piety and with folded hands said.

sa: तस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा वाजिमेधफलं लभेत्। सारस्वतीं गतिं चैव लभते नात्र संशयः॥
en: Bathing in that Tirtha, a man obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha sacrifice and he without any doubt obtains the region of Sarasvati.

sa: कृपेणच्छादितं दृष्ट्वा नृपोत्तम शिखण्डिनम्। प्रत्युद्यायौ कृपं तूर्णं धृष्टद्युम्नो महारथः॥
en: Beholding Shikhandin covered with arrows by Kripa, O foremost of kings, the mighty carwarrior Dhristadyumna speedily approached him.

sa: अस्य पुत्रं हृषीकेश सुवक्त्रं चारुकुण्डलम्। द्रोणेन समरे पश्य निकृतं बहुधा शरैः॥
en: Behold, O Hrishikesha, the son of that Dhrishtaketu, having fair locks and excellent car-rings, cut in battle by Drona with his arrows.

sa: एवं ममापि पुत्रस्य पुत्रः पितरमन्वगात्। दुर्योधनं महाबाहो लक्ष्मणः परवीरहा॥
en: Thus. also, my grandson, that slayer of hostile heroes, viz., the mighty-armed Lakshmana, has followed his father Duryodhana.

sa: ये हन्युः शस्त्रवेगेन देवानपि नरर्षभाः। त इमे निहताः संख्ये पश्य कालस्य पर्ययम्॥
en: Mark the reverses created by Time. Those leading warriors who could slay the very celestials by force of their arms have themselves been killed.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं मृदौ कथं तीक्ष्णे महापक्षे च पार्थिव। आदौ वर्तेत नृपतिस्तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O grandfather, how should a king treat a mild foe, one who is fierce, and one who has many allies and a large army.

sa: भो भो महर्षेधर्मज्ञ किमर्थं नृत्यते भवान्। हर्षस्थानं किमर्थं वा तवाद्य मुनिपुङ्गव॥
en: Shiva said: O great Rishi, O virtuous man, why are you dancing? O foremost of Rishis, why are you so much delighted?

sa: कलश्यां वार्युपस्पृश्य श्रद्दधानो जितेन्द्रियः। अग्निष्टोमस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः॥
en: Bathing in Kalasa with devotion and with one's passions subdued, a man obtains the fruits of Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sa: श्रुत्वा हनूमतो वाक्यं सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः। दर्शनीयतमो भूत्वा प्रीत्योवाच च राघवम्॥ भवान् धर्मविनीतश्च सुतपाः सर्ववत्सलः। आख्याता वायुपुत्रेण तत्त्वतो मे भवद्गुणाः॥
en: Hearing Hanuman's words, Sugrīva-lord of monkeys, becoming visible (at his will), gladly spoke to Rāghava, sir, you are versed in morality, and bear love towards all. The son of the wind-god has faithfully described your virtues to me.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच कानि लिङ्गानि दुष्टस्य भवन्ति द्विजसत्तम। कथं दुष्टं विजानीयामेतत् पृष्टो वदस्व मे॥
en: What are the marks, O best of the twiceborn, of a wicked person! Accosted by me, tell me how am I to know who is wicked!

sa: गत्वा हि श्रद्धया युक्तः कुरुक्षेत्रं कुरूद्वह। फलं प्राप्नोति च तदा राजसूयाश्वमेधयोः॥
en: O perpetuator of the Kuru race, he who goes to Kurukshetra with due respect, obtains the fruits of Rajasuya and Ashvamedha sacrifices,

sa: कुरुक्षेत्रं गमिष्यामि कुरुक्षेत्रे वसाम्यहम्। य एवं सततं ब्रूयात् सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते॥
en: He who always says, “I shall go to Kurukshetra, I shall live in Kurukshetra" is cleansed off all his sins.

sa: स मां त्वमनुजानीहि कृष्ण मोक्ष्ये कलेवरम्। त्वयाह समनुज्ञातो गच्छेयं परमां गतिम्॥
en: Do you, O Krishna, grant me leave. I shall renounce my body. Permitted by thec, I shall attain to the highest end.

sa: सादिनः सादिभिश्चैव गजैश्चापि महागजाः। असिभिः पदृिशैः प्रासैः शक्तिभिस्तोमरैरपि॥
en: The cavalry with cavalry and elephants with mighty elephants. With sword axes, Prasas, Shaktis, and Tomaras,

sa: सादिभिः सादिनां चापि पदातीनां पदातिभिः। उपाशाम्यद् रजो भौमं रुधिरेण प्रसर्पता॥
en: The cavalry (encountered) the cavalry and the infantry the infantry and the dreadful dust was drenched by the over-spreading blood.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। बृहस्पतिं वसुमना यथा पप्रच्छ भारत।॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old story, O Bharata, of the discourse of Brihaspati and Vasumanas..

sa: जनमेजय एवमुक्तो देवशुन्या सरमया भृशं संभ्रान्तो विषण्णश्चासीत्॥ स
en: Janamejaya, having been thus cursed by the celestial bitch, Sarama, was very much alarmed and dejected.

sa: विद्याभिजनसम्पन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि। शुचि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः॥
en: The wise see impartially a Brahmana gifted with knowledge and disciples, a cow, an elephant, a dog, and a Chandala.

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत्॥
en: Saluting Narayana, and to Nara, that foremost male-beings as also to the goddess Sarasvati, should the word Jaya be uttered.

sa: तं चोपाध्यायः प्रेषयामास-'वत्सोपमन्यो! गा रक्षस्व' इति॥
en: Him the preceptor thus addressed, “Go my child, look after my kine.

sa: उत्पन्नमिह लोके वै जन्मप्रभृति मानवम्। विविधामन्युपवर्तन्ते दुःखानि च सुखानि च।॥
en: Various sorts of sorrow and happiness overtake, from the day of birth, the person who is born on the Earth.

sa: ऋष्यमूकात् तु हनुमान् गत्वा तं मलयं गिरिम्। आचचक्षे तदा वीरौ कपिराजाय राघवौ॥
en: Having departed from Rşyamuka, and arrived at the Malaya hill, Hanumān informed the king of monkeys of (the arrival of) the descendants of Raghu.

sa: अथ कस्मिंश्चित् काले वेदं ब्राह्मणं जनमेजयः पौष्यश्च क्षत्रियावुपेत्य वरयित्वोपाध्यायं चक्रतुः॥
en: Once on a time both the kings Janamejaya and Paushya came to his house and appointed him as their preceptor.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनो राजा पुनर्घातरमब्रवीत्। सव्यं चक्रं युधामनुरुत्तमौजाश्च दक्षिणम्॥ गोप्तारावर्जुनस्यैतावर्जुनोऽपि शिखण्डिनः। रक्ष्माणः स पार्थेन तथास्माभिर्विवर्जितः॥ यथा भीष्मं न नो हन्याद् दुःशासन तथा कुरु। भ्रातुस्तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा पुत्रो दुःशासनस्तव॥
en: Thereafter king Duryodhana addressing his brothers once more said “Yudhamanyu protects the left wheel of Arjuna's chariot and Uttamaujas protects the right. Thus protected, Arjuna protects Shikhandin. O Dushasana, so arrange, that Shikhandin, thus protected by Arjuna, may not slay Bhishma left unprotected by ourselves.” Hearing the words of his brothers, your son Dushasana,

sa: एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं विस्तरेण महाद्युते। कुरूणां चरितं कृत्स्नं पाण्डवानां च भारत॥
en: I have now told you, you of great splendour, everything about the acts, O Bharatas, of both the Kurus and the Pandavas.

sa: राज्ञः समाज्ञापयत सेनां योजयतेति हा अद्य भीष्मो रणे क्रुद्धोनिहनिष्यति सोमकान्॥
en: Ordered, his royal warriors saying 'Arrange the forces in battle-order. Today, waxing irascible in battle, Bhishma shall slay the Somakas.'

sa: आगम्य तु ततो राजा विसृज्य च महाजनम्। प्रविवेश ततस्तूर्णं क्षयं शत्रुक्षयङ्करः॥
en: Thereafter the king reaching his own tent, and ordering his illustrious officers to retire, that destroyer of foes entered his own camp.

sa: पितामहनियोगाद् वै यो योगाद् गामधारयत्॥ यः स नारायणो नाम देवदेवः सनातनः। तस्यांशो वासुदेवस्तु कर्मणोऽन्ते विवेश ह॥
en: Through the command of the Grandsire, he, helped by his Yoga power, supported the Earth. Vasudeva was a part of that eternal god of gods, called Narayana. Accordingly, he entered into Narayana.

sa: सनत्कुमारं प्रद्युम्नः प्रविवेश यथागतम्॥ धृतराष्ट्रो धनेशस्य लोकान् प्राप दुरासदान्।
en: Pradyumna entered Sanatkumara whence he had come. Dhritarashtra obtained the regions, so difficult of acquisition, belonging to Kubera.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो विनशनं राजन् जगामाथ हलायुधः। शूद्राभीरान् प्रति द्वेषाद् यत्र नष्टा सरस्वती॥
en: Vaishampayana said "Then Baladeva, O king, went to Vinashana where the Sarasvati has disappeared out of view in consequence of her hatred for Shudras and Abhiras.

sa: तत्र गत्वा महाराज बलः श्वेतानुलेपनः। विधिवद्धि धनं दत्त्वा मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्॥
en: Besmeared with white sandal-paste O king, Baladeva, going to that tirtha, duly distributed wealth amongst many ascetics of pure souls.

sa: स एवमुक्त्वा तां क्षत्रियामामन्त्र्य पौष्यसकाशमागच्छत्। आह चैनं भोः पौष्य प्रीतोऽस्मीति तमुत्तकं पौष्यः प्रत्युवाच॥
en: Having said this, he took leave of the queen and went back to the king, whom he addressed thus, "Paushya, I am much pleased." Paushya replied,

sa: एष पाण्डुर्महेष्वासः कुन्त्या मात्र्या च संगतः। विमानेन सदाभ्येति पिता तव ममान्तिकम्॥
en: Here is the powerful bowman Pandu, now united with Kunti and Madri. Your father frequently comes to me on his excellent car.

sa: ते सर्वे ह्यशनं त्यक्त्वा फलं तस्य वनस्पतेः॥ व्रतैश्च नियमैश्चैव काले काले स्म भुञ्जते। प्राप्तैश्च नियमैस्तैस्तैर्विचरन्तः पृथक् पृथक्॥ अदृश्यमाना मनुजैर्व्यचरन् पुरुषर्षभ। एवं ख्यातो नरव्याघ्र लोकेऽस्मिन् स वनस्पतिः॥२४
en: Desisting from other kinds of food, all of them observe vows and regulations and take at the proper time the fruits of that king of the forest for their sustenance and rove separately unseen by men, O foremost of men. That monarch of the forest, O king, is celebrated throughout the world.

sa: नागा मे वशमीयुरिति। स चैनं पुरुषः पुनरुवाच एतमश्चमपाने धमस्वेति॥
en: Uttanka replied, “Let the Nagas be brought under my power." The man then said, “Blow into this horse."

sa: पथि गच्छता च मया ऋषभो दृष्टस्तं च पुरुषोऽधिरूढस्तेनाऽस्मि सोपचारमुक्त उत्तङ्कस्य ऋषभस्य पुरीषं भक्षय उपाध्यायेनापि ते भक्षितमिति॥
en: On my way I saw on the road a man mounted on a bull. He lovingly addressed me thus, “Uttanka, eat the dung of this bull, which was eaten by your preceptor."

sa: शिलावर्षं महत् तस्याः शरवर्षेण राघवः। प्रतिवार्योपधावन्त्याः करौ चिच्छेद पत्रिभिः॥
en: And resisting that mighty shower of crags by vollies of shafts, Rāghava with arrows cut off her hands.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततो मामब्रवीद् रामः प्रहसन्निव भारत। दिष्ट्या भीष्म मया साधू योद्धुमिच्छसि संगरे॥
en: Bhishma said Then did Rama say to me with a laugh, O Bharata:-It is fortunate, O Bhishma that you want to fight with me in battle.

sa: इति श्रुत्वा हृषीकेशः कामठं रूपमास्थितः॥ पर्वतं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा शिश्ये तत्रोदधौ हरिः।
en: Having heard this, Hrsikesa, or Hari, assuming the form of a tortoise, stood in the sea, supporting the hill on his back.

sa: न ताः स्म प्रतिगृह्णन्ति सर्वे ते देवदानवाः। अप्रतिग्रहणादेव ता वै साधारणाः स्मृताः॥
en: And neither the deities nor the Dānavas would accept them, and in consequence of this nonacceptance, they are known as women belonging to all.

sa: न भयाद् वासवस्यापि धर्म जह्यां महाव्रत। प्रसीद मा वा यद्वा ते कार्यं तत्कुरु मा चिरम्॥
en: O you of great vows, I shall not for fear of Vasava even forsake my duties; either be gratified with me or do what you please without loss of time.

sa: ध्रुवमद्यैव संहृष्टा लब्धलक्षाः प्लवंगमाः। आरोक्ष्यन्तीह दुर्गाणि लङ्काद्वाराणि सर्वशः॥
en: Surely today the monkeys overjoyed, finding occasion, well scale all the gateways and fortifications of Lankā.

sa: गुरुत्वं त्वयि सम्प्रेक्ष्य जामदग्न्य पुरातनम्। प्रसादये त्वां भगवस्त्यक्तैषा तु पुरा मया॥
en: O son of Jamadagni, considering that you were my preceptor in days of old I sought to gratify you before, my lord.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततस्तृतीये दिवसे संदिदेश व्यवस्थितः। कुरु प्रियं स मे राजन् प्राप्तोऽस्मीति महाव्रतः॥
en: Bhishma said On the third day of their encampment, the one of great vows sent me words: "I am come, do what is agreeable to me.”

sa: यदि भीष्मो रणश्लाघी न करिष्यति मे वचः। हनिष्याम्येनमुद्रिक्तमिति मे निश्चिता मतिः॥
en: If Bhishma, proud of his feats in war, does not act up to my commands I shall certainly slay that arrogant one.

sa: यो न देवासुरैः सर्वैः शक्यः प्रसहितुं युधि । तं पश्य सुखसंसुप्तं तृणेषु सह सीतया॥ यो मन्त्रतपसा लब्धो विविधैश्च पराक्रमैः। एको दशरथस्यैष पुत्रः सदृशलक्षणः॥ अस्मिन् प्रव्रजिते राजा न चिरं वर्तयिष्यति। विधवा मेदिनी नूनं क्षिप्रमेव भविष्यति॥
en: Him do you behold with ease asleep on the grass in company with Sītā, who was incapable of being borne in fight by the gods and the Asuras, and who obtained through Mantras and austerities and various endeavours, Dasaratha crowned with every auspicious mark, is the most meritorious son of the king. Rāma being banished, the king will not live long and the earth will shortly be widowed.

sa: सम्यगुक्तं हि भवता दूतवध्या विगर्हिता। अवश्यं तु वधायान्यः क्रियतामस्य निग्रहः॥
en: Properly had you spoken, to slay a messenger is improper. But let him be punished with any chastisement save slaying.

sa: सुवर्णानि द्विवर्णानि पुष्पाणि च फलानि च। सृजन्तः पादपास्तत्र व्याप्य तिष्ठन्ति तद् वनम्॥
en: The trees which stand there filling that forest, yield flowers and fruits which are of excellent colours and which are, besides of two kinds.

sa: स भूयः संगतैः क्रूरै राक्षसैर्हरिपुङ्गवः॥ सहस्त्रीबालवृद्धाश्च जग्मुः प्रीतिं निशाचराः।
en: And those-rangers of the night-those Rākşasas-old and young and females-again bringing that foremost of monkey, grew exceedingly glad.

sa: दह्यमाने च लाफूले चिन्तयामास वानरः। प्रदीप्तोऽग्निरयं कस्मान मां दहति सर्वतः॥
en: On his tail flaming, the monkey reflected, "This fire is flaming. Why dose it not then burn me all over"?

sa: नैतदीदृशकं युद्धं कृतवांस्तत्र फाल्गुनः। यादृशं कृतवान् युद्धं शिनेर्नप्ता महायशाः॥
en: Even Phalguna himself did not fight in the manner in which the illustrious grandson of Sini has fought.

sa: कथं च मम पुत्राणां जीवतां तत्र संजय। शैनेयोऽभिययौ युद्धे तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: O Sanjaya, tell me also, how could the grandson of Sini proceed to battle when all my sons were alive and fighting?

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच समप्रमृद्य महत् सैन्यं यान्तं शैनेयमर्जुनम्। निह्रींका मम ते पुत्राः किमकुर्वत संजय॥
en: Dhritarastra said What, O Sanjaya, did my shameless sons do when they beheld the grandson of Sini proceed towards Arjuna, crushing as he advanced my troops?

sa: स्वर्ग त्रिविष्टपं प्राप्य धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। दुर्योधनं श्रिया जुष्टं ददर्शासीनमासने॥
en: Arrived at Heaven, King Yudhishthira the just, saw Duryodhana gifted with prosperity and seated on an excellent seat.

sa: धर्षयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कां रावणान्तःपुरं तदा। दृष्टा संभाषिता चापि सीता ह्याश्वासिता तथा॥
en: Having discarded the presiding goddess of Lanka he went to the mansion of Rāvana and on beholding Sita there, he consoled her.

sa: परिश्रान्तो यदासीत् स ददद् दानान्यनेकशः। निवर्तयामास तदा दानयज्ञं नराधिपः॥
en: At last when he became tired with the work of making such profuse gifts, that great GiftSacrifice ended.

sa: एतस्मिन्प्लवमाने तु शिशुभावे हनूमति। देवदानवयक्षाणां विस्मयः सुमहानभूत्॥
en: The child Hanuman having thus ascended the sky, celestials, Dānavas and Yakşas surprisingly exclaimed.

sa: अत्र तावद् यथाबुद्धिः सर्वैरेव यथाविधि। भावस्य निश्चयस्तावद् विज्ञेयो निपुणं शनैः॥
en: It behoveth you all, to ascertain now speedily according to your knowledge and right understanding (the cause of Laksmana's wrath).

sa: उत्सृज्यामिमं राम प्रधावन्तं प्लवंगमम्। अवेक्ष्यैवं परावृत्तो मुखशेषः पराङ्मुखः॥
en: Beholding Hanuman approach renouncing the sun, Rāhu with his countenance only visible, desisted and went back.

sa: ऐरावतं ततो दृष्ट्वा महत्तदिदमित्यपि। फलं तं हस्तिराजानमभिदुद्राव मारुतिः॥
en: Thereupon beholding the huge-bodied Airāvat and considering him as a bigger fruit Măruti ran towards him.

sa: न स क्षमः कोपयितुं यः प्रसाद्यः पुनर्भवेत्। पूर्वोपकारं स्मरता कृतज्ञेन विशेषतः॥
en: Remembering his former service, it does not behove you, grateful as you are, to excite his wrath, who should be pleased again.

sa: कच्चिन्न दीनः सम्भ्रान्तः कार्येषु च न मुह्यति। कच्चित् पुरुषकार्याणि कुरुते नृपतेः सुतः॥
en: Has he forgotten his work being overwhelmed with fear and poorliness of heart? Is that son of the king performing still his manly duties?

sa: सुखानामुचितो नित्यमसुखानामनूचितः। दुःखमुत्तरमासाद्य कच्चिद् रामो न सीदति ॥
en: Has not Rāma, ever used to happiness and unused to misery, been enfeebled by this disaster?

sa: तवादर्शनजेनार्ये शोकेन परिपूरितः। न शर्म लभते रामः सिंहार्दित इव द्विपः॥
en: O worshipful dame, stricken with grief in your absence, Rāma is restless like to an elephant smitten by a lion.

sa: पूजितो भुजगैर्वीरं आशीभिश्चाभिनन्दितः। दिव्याभरणसंछन्नो नागानामन्त्र्य पाण्डवः॥ उदतिष्ठत् प्रहृष्टात्मा नागलोकादरिंदमः। उत्क्षिप्तः स तु नागेन जलाज्जलरुहेक्षणः॥ तस्मिन्नेव वनोद्देशे स्थापितः कुरुनन्दनः। ते चान्तर्दधिरे नागाः पाण्डवस्यैव पश्यतः॥
en: That chastiser of foes (Bhima) rose from the abode of the Nagas in delightful heart. The lotus eyed (hero), being upraised by the Nagas from the water, was placed in the self same gardens, where he had been sporting. They then vanished in his own sight.

sa: तमुक्तवन्तं वैदेहं विश्वामित्रो महामुनिः। उवाच वचनं वीरं वसिष्ठसहितो नृपम्॥
en: When Vaideha had spoken thus, the mighty ascetic Viśvāmitra is company with Vasiștha addressed that heroic king, saying.

sa: आगताः स्म महाभागे व्याकुलेनान्तरात्मना। इहागम्य क्व नु गतस्त्वया वा प्रेषितः क्व नु॥
en: O illustrious lady, we have come here, our hearts being great anxiety. Coming here, where has he gone? Have you sent him any where?

sa: गवां शतसहस्रं च ब्राह्मणेभ्यो नराधिपः। एकैकशो ददौ राजा पुत्रानुद्दिश्य धर्मतः॥
en: And to Brāhmaṇas the monarch severally gavę away kine by hundreds and by thousands, for the welfare of his sons.

sa: सप्तधा तु कृते गर्भे दितिः परमदुःखिता। सहस्राक्षं दुराधर्षं वाक्यं सानुनयाब्रवीत्॥
en: When the embryo had been sundered is seven, Díti exceedingly aggrieved humbly spoke to the irrepressible thousand-eyed deity, saying, as

sa: साभ्यर्च्य तौ तदा वीरौ प्रीत्या चाभ्यधिकं ततः। पुत्रं दामोदरोत्सङ्गे देवी संन्यदधात् स्वयम्॥
en: When those two heroes were duly worshipped, the queen with great pleasure and joy herself placed the child on the lap of Damodara (Krishna).

sa: ततः समासाद्य महानुभावं कृष्णस्तदा दारुकमन्वशासत्। सर्वमिमं महान्तं पार्थाय शंसस्व वधं यदूनाम्॥
en: Finding Rama of great soul, Krishna ordered Daruka, saying, 'Going to the Kurus, inform Partha of this great carnage of the Yadus.

sa: यदि शूर्पणखाहेतोर्जनस्थानगतः खरः। अतिवृत्तो हतः पूर्वं रामेणक्लिष्टकर्मणा। अत्र ब्रूहि यथातत्वं को रामस्य वयतिक्रमः॥
en: Though the wicked Khara of Janasthāna has been slain by him on Sūrpanakhā's account, yet how is he to blame for it do you truly speak.

sa: अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत्। इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम्॥
en: But O chief son of Bharata, Raja Sacrifice is that which is performed in expectation of receiving fruits from it and for ostentatious show.

sa: स तदा वालिनं हत्वा सुग्रीवमभिषिच्य च। वसन् माल्यवतः पृष्ठे रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon encompassing the destruction of Vāli, installing Sugrīva and dwelling on the summit of the Mālyabana hill, Rāma spoke to Laksmana, saying,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथा लालप्यमाने तुधर्मराजे युधिष्ठिरे। धौम्यप्रभृतयः सर्वे तत्राजग्मुर्द्विजोत्तमाः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When Dharmaraja Yudhishthira was thus lamenting, Dhaumya and other foremost of Brahmanas all came there.

sa: सेव्यमाना च शीतेन जलमिश्रेण वायुना। पाञ्चाली सुखमासाद्य लेभे चेतः शनैः शनैः॥
en: And also on being fanned by the cool breeze surcharged with water, the Panchala princess felt ease and slowly regained her consciousness.
